Name: Fippsie's Alternative Lamp Posts
Author: Fippsie
Description:
[center]
Are you also bored by the default Lamp Posts?
This mod allows you to replace both the Wood and Stone Lamp Posts with 5 different Lamp Posts. :) 

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI﻿[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]﻿.
3. Download and unzip the folder into \Stardew Valley\Mods\.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.

To uninstall, just delete it from the mods folder.

This mod uses the "Classic" design by default. To choose which lamp post you want to use:

1. Start the game using SMAPI at least once before doing anything.
2. Go to \Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Fippsie's Alternative Lamp Posts
3. Open the config.json and replace Classic with whichever lamp post you want to use: Classic, Crystal Big, Crystal Small, Fairy, Flower Pink, Flower Yellow, Lewis, Mine, Monster, Palm Star, Pam, Pam Golden, Portal, Round, Rustic, Star, Stardrop, Tiki, Ufo, Ufo Hover. Make sure you don't remove the " " and spell the names correctly.

You can use the same design for both the stone and the wood lamp posts, or mix them up!


[size=1][i]Special thanks to: Moo and everyone on the discord for helping me with the code!
